tests.name: test_cbor_unexpected_end_of_input
tests.intent: Probes binary reader behavior when CBOR input abruptly ends, triggering report_eof/last_byte_error.

tests.name: test_bson_document_size_error
tests.intent: Probes BSON document size mismatch error handling where document size does not match bytes read.

tests.name: test_bson_length_error_string
tests.intent: Probes BSON string length error handling for negative or zero string lengths.

tests.name: test_bson_length_error_binary
tests.intent: Probes BSON binary array negative length error handling.

tests.name: test_bson_unsupported_type_error
tests.intent: Probes BSON parsing with an unsupported record type to exercise bson_unsupported_type_error.

tests.name: test_cbor_indefinite_string_error
tests.intent: Probes CBOR indefinite string error handling when nested incorrectly.

tests.name: test_cbor_string_length_specification_error
tests.intent: Probes CBOR string parsing where an unexpected token breaks the expected length specification.

tests.name: test_cbor_object_key_non_string
tests.intent: Probes CBOR object parsing where a non-string key is encountered.

tests.name: test_cbor_binary_length_specification_error
tests.intent: Probes CBOR binary chunk parsing when length specification fails.

tests.name: test_container_too_large_error_cbor
tests.intent: Probes container size limit checks during CBOR parsing triggering container_too_large out_of_range.

tests.name: test_msgpack_string_length_error
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack string parsing error when input ends prematurely.

tests.name: test_msgpack_object_key_non_string
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack object parsing with non-string keys.

tests.name: test_ubjson_integer_overflow
tests.intent: Probes UBJSON container count integer overflow checking out_of_range.

tests.name: test_bjdata_excluded_optimized_type
tests.intent: Probes BJData excluded optimized type handling calling optimized_type_error.

tests.name: test_ubjson_missing_hash_after_type
tests.intent: Probes UBJSON container type-size specification missing '#' marker error.

tests.name: test_ubjson_char_out_of_range
tests.intent: Probes UBJSON optimized char container byte range validation error.

tests.name: test_msgpack_container_size_overflow
tests.intent: Probes MessagePack valueless or normal container size overflow checking out_of_range.

tests.name: test_ubjson_ndarray_size_overflow
tests.intent: Probes UBJSON ndarray size multiplication overflow checking out_of_range.

tests.name: test_check_container_size_helper
tests.intent: Probes check_container_size / container_too_large_error with explicit container max_size bounds via SAX parse.

tests.name: test_binary_reader_valid_cbor_roundtrip
tests.intent: Probes normal successful binary reader execution path to confirm error refactoring leaves valid inputs unaffected.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Trigger unexpected_byte and tail formatting in last_byte_error by providing an invalid string length specification in CBOR.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Trigger unexpected_byte with tail in CBOR object key parsing where an invalid non-string key is encountered.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Trigger unexpected_byte in binary chunk parsing when an unexpected marker follows CBOR binary data prefix.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger out_of_range_error with integer value overflow during UBJSON container dimension parsing.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Trigger report_eof and unexpected end of input error message with context via incomplete binary input.
